Velvet Capital is a social trading terminal for non-custodial crypto trading — spot, perpetual futures (perps) and yield strategies on Robinhood Chain, Solana, Base, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Hyperliquid, Ink, Monad, Sonic and other chains.
